name: raw_tile_stall_measurement
hypothesis: The v89 neutral-stall detector mistakes productive land growth for a stall because tileShare is rounded. Exact own-tile history should preserve land expansion while raw tiles are still rising and retain the existing escape branch only when raw tiles are flat.

candidate.source_delta: Conditionally persist validated own tiles as a selector-private, non-enumerable state field and veto the rounded-share stall only when the current raw count exceeds the oldest count in a complete four-record window. The optional planner therefore receives the exact parent JSON state. Preserve the exact parent state/history shape and tileShare behavior when raw history is absent or non-growing. The previously verified Gravity identity protection remains a mandatory K1Z invariant.

causal_contract.guard: The legacy rounded-share detector reports a neutral stall; current plus four recent raw tile counts are valid; current raw tiles exceed the oldest count; a parent escape boat or build is available; a different neutral land action is legal; and no parent counterattack, pressure, collapse, or cadence-build branch outranks it.
causal_contract.action_change: Replace that exact parent escape action with the normal v89 neutral-land action.
causal_contract.marker: rs1 only when the selected neutral-land action ID differs from the available parent escape action ID.
causal_contract.failure: Reject on zero marker reach, any unexplained hold/reject, any K1Z harm, or no matched opening-territory advantage. Do not tune the percentage cadence or add a scheduler.

replay_basis.false_stall_action: neutral boat selected while land35 remained legal

source_gate.red_first: exact safety-invariant base: core rising-raw test fails; five counterfactual lock-ins pass
source_gate.planner_prompt_parity: red-first proof: raw tiles remain selector-readable and persist into history, but are non-enumerable and absent from JSON.stringify(state); old source failed; red log sha256 60de48b49ea62786b76dffd25dc6807fc0bf134f10c79f0cd7409438d8833fc8
source_gate.independent_rci: PASS after revision; 2,000 missing-raw differentials had zero parent mismatches and 5,000 targeted cases had zero false-positive rs1 markers

local_canary.purpose: Fail fast on one trace-proven repair cell. This canary proves mechanism reach and directional opening lift only; it is not the full local matched gate.
local_canary.control_opportunity: The prior exact-parent trace first becomes RS1-eligible at active decision 21 / turn 2400, not turn 2200: observation-side own tiles are 32321 and the four raw history records are 32167/32167/32167/32168; rounded share remains 0.08 with three recent neutral land attacks; threat count is zero; no hostile attack ID is legal; cadence build is false; the only legal attacks are Terra Nullius 10/20/35; and control selects accepted boat:442484:8. At turn 2200 observation-side tiles are still flat, while at turn 2300 a disciplined rival attack retains precedence. The safety-invariant base differs only in K1Z Gravity identity protection and must reproduce the turn-2400 opportunity before the candidate may run.
local_canary.pass: Control reproduces the legacy turn-2400 opportunity. Before turn 2400, candidate and control must have exact all-lobby selected-action and ordered-legal-action traces, and exact subject observation-side ownTiles/share plus fallback/degraded mode. Candidate then emits reason token rs1 on an accepted Terra Nullius land action (expected expand:terra-nullius:10) that replaces the corresponding control boat/build action. Every decision is accepted; zero unexplained holds, rejects, or K1Z harm; and candidate AUC25, defined as sum(tacticalAffordances.openingExpansionTempo.ownTiles at each of the first 25 non-spawn subject decisions minus that field at the first non-spawn subject decision), is strictly greater than control AUC25. Detect reach from the rs1 reason token because decisions.jsonl does not reliably expose policyMarker.
local_canary.archived_reference: The prior exact-v89 trace has subject AUC25 516155, first source-state tile count 52, and decision-25 source-state tile count 32479. The rerun control must establish its own baseline; this reference cannot substitute for the control job.
local_canary.failure: Reject RS1 immediately if the control opportunity is absent, marker reach is zero, the pre-marker trace diverges, any safety gate fails, or AUC25 does not improve.
local_canary.next_on_pass: Run a cheap safety-base-only adjacent-seed reach scan. Run the candidate only for the first fresh seed with a preregistered opportunity. The full local matched gate still requires two independent reach cells and at least 10 percent mean AUC25 lift.

gates.source: red-first rising-raw regression, flat-raw lock-in, full suite, exact linux/amd64 image byte check
gates.local: slot-0 fail-fast canary first, followed only on pass by one fresh adjacent-seed control/candidate cell; marker reach in both independent cells, all accepted, zero unexplained holds/rejects/K1Z harm, positive AUC25 in both and at least 10 percent mean gain
gates.promotion: automatic only after every gate in AUTONOMOUS_PROMOTION.md passes
